* '''Playtest''' (this page, 22 June 2021): Playtest image, published the day before the set's official release (23 June 2021) and replaced on release day. Players Committee card image, 22 June 2021: 0 side [[:File:V15-L-deathstardetentionblockcorridor-original.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/death_star_detention_block_corridor.png Holotable commit ee4c4cd “Set 15 cards + errata images”], no mark). Text: Light Side: “If you control with a spy, may use 2 Force to release Leia here (retrieve 1 Force).” Dark Side: “If Leia is about to be lost from a Death Star site, imprison her here instead (even if inactive).” '''What changed:''' the card image is stored upright (portrait, 703×980); it was replaced on release day by the same card turned to landscape.
* '''Original''' ([[Death Star: Detention Block Corridor (V)]], 23 June 2021): Original: the image at the set's official release (23 June 2021). Players Committee card image, 23 June 2021: 0 side [[:File:V15-L-deathstardetentionblockcorridor-20210623.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9319460/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstardetentionblockcorridor.png Holotable commit 9319460 “fixing rotation on v15”], no mark). Text: Light Side: “If you control with a spy, may use 2 Force to release Leia here (retrieve 1 Force).” Dark Side: “If Leia is about to be lost from a Death Star site, imprison her here instead (even if inactive).” '''What changed:''' the same card image turned 90° to landscape (980×703, was 703×980); the words and mark are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
*: [[File:V15-L-deathstardetentionblockcorridor-20210623-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Death Star: Detention Block Corridor (V) (Errata)]], 20 April 2022): '''First published 20 April 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstardetentionblockcorridor.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2640d508acff17553640735ee7a15ad93fa78a65 commit 2640d50]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Players Committee card image, 20 April 2022: 0 side [[:File:V15-L-deathstardetentionblockcorridor-20220420.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2640d50/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstardetentionblockcorridor.png Holotable commit 2640d50 “Set 18 and errata”], no mark). Text: Light Side: “If you control with a spy, may use 2 Force to release Leia here (retrieve 1 Force).” Dark Side: “If Leia is about to be lost from a Death Star site, imprison her here instead (even if inactive).” '''What changed:''' the card was re-rendered at a higher resolution (1039×745, was 980×703); the words, layout and mark are unchanged. Listed as its own version under Bill's rulings of 12 November 2026 (every visible change on a PC image is a version). This image was first published on 20 April 2022 as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstardetentionblockcorridor.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2640d508acff17553640735ee7a15ad93fa78a65 commit 2640d50]); the card-size GIF uploaded 11 June 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c commit 6894629], earlier listed as its own version, PC-E2) is a later copy of the same image in another format, so it is not a new version (a version is one distinct image, dated when it was first published in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
*: [[File:V15-L-deathstardetentionblockcorridor-20220420-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Death Star: Detention Block Corridor (V) (Errata 2)]], 11 December 2022): Players Committee card image, 11 December 2022: 0 side [[:File:V15-L-deathstardetentionblockcorridor-20221211.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e9980f9/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstardetentionblockcorridor.png Holotable commit e9980f9 “Set 20 Errata, 2020 AIs, and a few fixes”], mark “E1”). Text: Light Side: “If you control with a spy, may use 2 Force to release Leia here (retrieve 1 Force).” Dark Side: “If [Set 20] Leia is about to leave table (for any reason, even if inactive), imprison her here instead.” '''What changed:''' Dark Side: “If Leia is about to be lost from a Death Star site, imprison her here instead (even if inactive).” became “If [Set 20] Leia is about to leave table (for any reason, even if inactive), imprison her here instead.” Light Side unchanged. '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 3 by release order (PC-E3); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].

Text: Light Side: “If you control with a spy, may use 2 Force to release Leia here (retrieve 1 Force).” Dark Side: “Once per game, may ▼ a non-[Maintenance] Imperial trooper here.” '''What changed:''' Dark Side became “Once per game, may ▼ a non-[Maintenance] Imperial trooper here.” (the Leia imprisonment clause is gone). Light Side unchanged. '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E2”, but this is errata version 4 by release order (PC-E4); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
